title: Path tracer benchmark record
description: One benchmark measurement, as written by 'pathtracer --bench'. Records are stored as NDJSON: this schema validates a single line, not the file.

schema_version.description: Bumped on any change to the record's shape or to the meaning of a field, additive or not. A consumer requires an exact match rather than tolerating unknown or missing fields.

scene.description: Scene file path as given on the command line, relative to the repository root.

timestamp.description: UTC, second resolution. Captured when the measurement is taken, not when the record is written.

cpu_model.description: From /proc/cpuinfo, or 'unknown' where the kernel does not report one.

arch.description: Compile-time target architecture. Counters are only comparable within one value.

logical_cores.description: Cores the machine has, not threads the render used. 0 means the count was unavailable.

build_type.description: CMake configuration name. 'Release' is the only one a timing may be quoted from.

scalar.description: The engine's Float type. A different scalar type changes both speed and results.

stats_enabled.description: True when traversal counters were compiled in. Such a build carries them in the hot loop and must not be timed.

threads.description: Worker threads the render actually used.

samples_per_pixel.description: The count the renderer used, always a perfect square, never the requested value.

seed.description: Base sampling seed. Unsigned 64-bit; values above 2^53 lose precision in a consumer that parses JSON numbers as doubles.

runs.description: Length of render_seconds. The schema cannot express that equality; a consumer should check it.

render_seconds.description: Every timed run, in order. Kept so the spread stays visible behind the reported figure.

render_seconds_min.description: The reported figure: a slow run means interference, never a faster renderer. Null when nothing was timed.

primary_rays.description: width * height * samples_per_pixel. One primary ray per sample; bounces are not counted here.

primary_rays_per_second.description: Derived from render_seconds_min, so the two describe the same run. Null when nothing was timed.

peak_rss_bytes.description: Process-wide high-water mark. Includes scene loading and BVH construction, which the timed runs exclude. Null where the platform does not report it.

trees.description: BVHs the scene built. A subtree shared by several parents is built once and counted once.

nodes.description: Entries in the flat node arrays: interior nodes plus leaves.

leaves.description: Leaf nodes, each holding a contiguous range of primitives.

max_depth.description: Longest root-to-node path over all trees. A single-node tree has depth 0.

build_ms.description: Total construction time over all trees.

traversal.description: Null unless build.stats_enabled is true. Counters and a timing from this record's own build are never both trustworthy.

node_tests.description: Bounding box tests. Both children are tested before descending, leaves included.

leaf_tests.description: hit() calls the BVH issues on the objects it holds. Tests inside an aggregate object are not counted.

ray_queries.description: Top-level hit() calls: primary rays plus every bounce.
